operational_consequence: After all three participants seal their ledgers, an engineer still has to regain adjudicator authority and call an internal raw-token API to create the exact M57.2 pre-outcome manifest. That breaks participant-owned workflow completion and leaves no explicit adjudicator attribution for the export action.
decision: Proceed with one post-seal CSRF-protected adjudicator confirmation that previews the exact manifest hash, durably records intent, delegates the unchanged M57.4 export and records an identical-only M57.9 receipt. Preserve all evidence semantics and formal-denial gates.
